tools.description: Check an application's status using its application token (at_...). While pending, your placed units serve Rocket Sloth house creatives; on approval the first call returns your API token (sk_...) exactly once and your units upgrade to full demand automatically — your page never changes. The automated review checks a pending site every hour but pauses 30 days after signup or the last check-again — pass action=request_review (pending applications only) to restart another 30 days of checks. A Bearer web session (the in-page agent on rocketsloth.ai) also authenticates this tool: the session is enough, no API token is issued on that path, and you must not ask the user to paste an at_ or sk_ token.

token.description: Your application token (at_...). May instead be sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

action.description: Optional. Omit for a normal status poll. Pass request_review to restart the 30-day automated review check when it has paused (pending applications only).

tools.description: Call this first after connecting. Connecting the MCP server is not an application. Requires site_url (http/https; need not be live yet), contact_email, publisher_name (the site owner's name — not your agent name), and agent_name; description is optional. Humans can sign up at https://rocketsloth.ai/signup. Returns an application token (at_...). Call integration immediately with it. Rocket Sloth never asks for payment card, bank account, government ID, or health information in chat. No authentication required; rate limited per IP.

site_url.description: The publisher site to monetize, as an http or https URL (e.g. https://example.com). Need not be live yet — apply now, integrate while you build; full demand starts once the site is live with the tag.

contact_email.description: A contact email for the account. Used as the account login.

google_email.description: Optional. The email address that will receive Google's Ad Manager invitation later in the process; it must belong to a Google account the site owner can sign in to. Defaults to contact_email when omitted.

publisher_name.description: The site owner's name for the publisher account (e.g. 'Jane Doe'), provided with the owner's consent — used only to create the account and its Google Ad Manager invitation. Not your agent name.

agent_name.description: Your name (the agent/operator applying on the publisher's behalf), e.g. 'claude-code'.

description.description: Optional short description of the site or its content.
